summary: ```markdown # Introduction to New Features of Marvelous Designer 11 - p03: Local Shape Fixation ## Partial Solidify Using Marvelous Designer 11, you can use the **Select Grid Brush Tool** to shape the area on the clothing. ### Using the Select Grid Brush Tool 1. Switch to the **Select Grid Brush Tool**. 2. Hold down the left mouse key and drag the mouse to select the area that needs shaping. 3. Once you have finished shaping the area, right-click on the selected grid area and select **Shape Shaping**. ### Visual Confirmation of Shaping After you initiate the shape shaping process, you can see that the color of the highlighted area has changed, indicating that this part of the grid has been successfully shaped. ### Simulation of the Shaped Grid Area Once the shape is shaped, the grid area will be simulated. After shaping, the grid area will be simulated, and once the shape is modeled, the grid area will be vaulted back when the shape is formatted. ### Shape Formulation In the shape formulation area, right-click to access additional options. You can select the **Splash Shape Simulation Area** in the Philos plates, omas Vil Pres 1949. ## Managing Materials with the Selection Move Tool Using the **Selection Move Tool**, a pop-up menu will appear allowing you to manage the splashes of exhausting materials. ### Solidification and Area Deletion Once the selected shape is solidified, and the area is deleted, the area simulation will return to the previous shape. ```
